PLAN 05 | SHOTS 12-13 | THE CORRIDOR
Create a 15-second Seedance 2.5 cinematic sequence, horizontal 16:9. Exactly 2 shots with the local timing below. Preserve the assigned identities, masks, wardrobe, animal design and location geometry. Performance is expressed through posture, hands, breathing and weight. Render at natural speed with tactile analog texture.
CHARACTER REFERENCES
CHAR_SHAHRNAZ = {{CHAR_SHAHRNAZ}}
CHAR_ARNAVAZ = {{CHAR_ARNAVAZ}}
CHAR_GUARD_A = {{CHAR_GUARD_A}}
CHAR_GUARD_B = {{CHAR_GUARD_B}}
CHAR_GUARD_C = {{CHAR_GUARD_C}}
ANIMAL REFERENCES
ANIMAL_CAT = {{ANIMAL_CAT}}
LOCATION REFERENCES
LOC_TRANSFER_CORRIDOR = {{LOC_TRANSFER_CORRIDOR}}
START STATE AND BLOCKING
STATE_TRANSFER. Five adults and one cat. A leads Shahrnaz by her left upper sleeve, leaving both forearms supporting the cat. B holds Arnavaz’s right upper arm; C holds her left upper arm. Travel is left-to-right toward the hall. The private room is behind them.

SHOT 12 | 00:00-00:08 | THE GROUP IN TRANSIT
28mm shoulder-height handheld camera retreats in the existing corridor ahead of the group. A and Shahrnaz lead; B and C bring Arnavaz behind. Shahrnaz’s small uneven steps contrast with Arnavaz planting her heels. Keep the cat visible through at least two clear gaps between bodies.
SHOT 13 | 00:08-00:15 | A SMALL OPENING
Cut to 40mm from the same side of the travel axis. Arnavaz reaches toward Shahrnaz as C briefly adjusts his left-arm grip. She slips that arm free, pivots toward the nearest wall recess and braces one foot. B keeps her right upper arm. A halts Shahrnaz ahead. End on Arnavaz’s resisted pivot, with her head clear of the wall.
LIGHT AND IMAGE
Harder localized corridor light alternates with shadow as the group crosses existing openings. Preserve the same wardrobe, masks and wall geometry.
SOUND
Boots, dragging soles, garment tension, uneven breathing, short enclosed echoes. Shahrnaz’s voice remains silent; distress is bodily.
END STATE AND EDIT
Arnavaz frees her left arm as C adjusts his grip and turns sideways in a brief escape attempt. B retains her right arm. Shahrnaz and A stop one meter ahead; the cat remains in Shahrnaz’s arms.
Keep all character designs and prop ownership consistent across cuts. Use the camera paths stated for each shot and retain readable spatial relationships. Primitive ritual fashion cinema, analog realism. NO MUSIC, NO DIALOGUE.

Create a 15-second cinematic sequence for Seedance 2.5.
Horizontal 16:9.
Exactly six shots with the timing below.

Build an escalating, physically exhausting struggle inside the transfer corridor. Arnavaz’s resistance repeatedly disrupts the guards’ control. Shahrnaz freezes nearby, terrified, holding her frightened cat.

CHARACTER REFERENCES:
Shahrnaz = {{CHAR_SHAHRNAZ}}
Arnavaz = {{CHAR_ARNAVAZ}}
Guard A = {{CHAR_GUARD_A}}
Guard B = {{CHAR_GUARD_B}}
Guard C = {{CHAR_GUARD_C}}

ANIMAL REFERENCE:
Cat = {{ANIMAL_CAT}}

LOCATION REFERENCE:
Transfer corridor = {{LOC_TRANSFER_CORRIDOR}}

Preserve the exact referenced masks, costumes, body proportions, cat and corridor architecture.

START STATE AND GEOGRAPHY:

The group has entered the corridor from the sisters’ room.

Shahrnaz has stopped beside Guard A, one meter ahead of Arnavaz. She holds the cat against her chest with both forearms. A maintains his grip on her left upper arm.

Behind them, B grips Arnavaz’s right upper arm and C grips her left upper arm.

The destination lies toward frame-right. The nearest wall recess is beside Arnavaz.

Five adults and one living cat occupy the sequence.

SHOT 12A | 00:00–00:02 | SHE STOPS THEM

24mm close handheld at hip height beside Arnavaz.

Arnavaz suddenly drops her weight, plants both feet and throws her shoulders backward against the guards’ forward pull.

Their movement stops abruptly. B takes an involuntary recovery step; C’s arm jerks straight as he struggles to hold her.

The camera drops with her weight and jolts sideways when B’s body crowds the operator.

Cut while her soles are still scraping against the stone.

SHOT 12B | 00:02–00:04.5 | BREAKING THEIR BALANCE

28mm tight handheld from the same side of the struggle.

Arnavaz twists sharply toward C, folds her left elbow inward and drives her shoulder against his chest.

C loses half a step and hits the wall with his shoulder. His grip slips lower along her arm.

B pulls her right arm back toward him. She immediately turns against that pull, forcing him to widen his stance.

The camera lurches between their shoulders, briefly screened by C’s moving body, then recovers on Arnavaz still fighting between them.

Her movement has real weight and forces both men to react.

SHOT 12C | 00:04.5–00:06.5 | SHAHRNAZ CANNOT MOVE

35mm close handheld on Shahrnaz beside A.

She watches her sister’s struggle, shoulders raised and body rigid. One foot starts toward Arnavaz, then stops as A tightens his hold.

The frightened cat presses into her chest with flattened ears. Shahrnaz shifts her supporting hand beneath its body and curls around it.

Her breathing becomes short and shallow. She remains beside A, visibly afraid to act.

The camera trembles with the operator’s unsettled footing. A struggling shoulder repeatedly enters the near foreground.

Cut on a sudden scuff of boots behind her.

SHOT 12D | 00:06.5–00:09.5 | REACHING FOR HER SISTER

24mm close handheld beside Arnavaz, with Shahrnaz visible ahead through the guards.

Arnavaz sees her sister and surges toward her.

She drags B forward one stumbling step while C hangs onto her left arm. Her left hand reaches toward Shahrnaz as far as his grip allows.

C catches her higher on the upper arm and pulls sideways. Arnavaz turns fiercely back toward him, then immediately tries to drive forward again.

The camera rushes with her first lunge, stops hard when the guards arrest it and makes an abrupt lateral correction to recover her reaching hand.

Cut before the struggle settles.

SHOT 12E | 00:09.5–00:12 | THE GUARDS LOSE PATIENCE

28mm compressed, close handheld framing of torsos, gripping hands and planted feet.

B closes both hands around Arnavaz’s right upper arm. C readjusts his hold on her left side.

Their effort has changed: shoulders pitch forward, breathing becomes forceful, grips tighten and their movements grow abrupt.

Arnavaz stamps one foot down to regain leverage, twists her hips and tries to wrench her left shoulder free. B’s boot skids as he counters her.

The camera dips toward the sliding feet, then whips back to the locked arms with a rough correction.

The guards’ anger is visible through physical force and increasingly impatient reactions beneath their fixed masks.

SHOT 12F | 00:12–00:15 | ONE MORE ATTEMPT

24mm handheld beside the wall recess.

As C shifts his grip, Arnavaz tears her left arm free and pivots sharply toward the recess, trying to escape their control.

B retains her right upper arm. His arm pulls taut as her body turns away.

C steps toward her left rear to seize her again.

Ahead, Shahrnaz recoils against A’s restraining hand, still holding the cat.

The camera snaps sideways with Arnavaz’s pivot and ends close to her braced body, her free left hand reaching for space.

Cut at maximum tension: B still holds her right arm, C is closing from behind, and Arnavaz is still upright and resisting beside the wall.

This is the exact starting position for the following block’s violent retaliation.

CAMERA AND EDITING:

The camera remains intensely handheld throughout.

Use hurried sidesteps, abrupt changes of balance, downward dips, sharp lateral corrections and brief obstruction by shoulders and arms. The operator struggles to keep up inside the narrow corridor.

Maintain close wide-angle proximity and deep focus so hands, bodies and spatial relationships remain readable together. Momentary motion blur belongs to the hardest camera jolts.

Each cut discovers a different part of one continuous struggle: planted feet, slipping grip, frightened witness, reaching hand, tightening restraint, renewed escape.

Preserve the corridor axis and character assignments across every cut.

PERFORMANCE:

Push the physical intensity.

Arnavaz fights with her entire body. Every blocked attempt immediately becomes another attempt. Her goal remains visible: reach Shahrnaz and escape the guards.

B and C visibly struggle to contain her. Their balance is disrupted, their breathing grows heavier and their restraint becomes increasingly forceful.

Shahrnaz remains immobilized by fear beside A. Her protective grip and small adjustments keep the frightened cat securely supported.

The struggle escalates through this block; the wall impact and blows belong to the following block.

LIGHT AND SOUND:

Use the corridor’s established practical light. Moving bodies repeatedly interrupt it, producing hard shifting shadows across fabric and stone.

Keep the sound close and crowded: skidding boots, heels grinding against stone, clothing pulled taut, strained breathing, C’s shoulder contacting the wall, the cat’s frightened breath and short corridor echoes.

Carry the sounds of resistance continuously across cuts.

END STATE:

Arnavaz’s left arm is free and her body is pivoting beside the wall recess.
B retains her right upper arm.
C stands at her left rear, moving to recapture her.
A and Shahrnaz remain one meter ahead.
The cat remains alive and securely held against Shahrnaz’s chest.

NO MUSIC, NO DIALOGUE.

- No human appears without a mask. Every person on screen, including nobles, gift-bearers, servants and background figures, wears a mask. A figure who is not a named character takes one of the masked caste looks in REF-001, Civilization Caste Board. Never show a bare human face.
